title: Why Risks Can Go Wrong
description: 完整答案表、全文段落速覽，以及逐題 Skim、Scan、Read、同義改寫與中伏位分析。

questions.answer: vi — A successful approach to the study of decision-making
questions.answerKey: vi — A successful approach to the study of decision-making
questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: 題目要求：Paragraph B 的 heading。這題要找整段主旨，而不是某一個細節。Paragraph B 的核心是 Kahneman 如何把心理學應用到經濟、商業和決策研究，並成功建立影響力。
目標段落是 Paragraph B。第一句是：
“In the 1960s, a young American research psychologist, Daniel Kahneman, became interested in people’s inability to make logical decisions.”
中文意思：在 1960 年代，年輕的美國研究心理學家 Daniel Kahneman 對人們不能作出合乎邏輯
的決定產生興趣。
最後一句是：
“He claims that, far from being random, these mistakes are systematic and predictable.”
中文意思：他聲稱，這些錯誤絕非隨機；它們有系統，也可以預測。
只看首尾句，可以先估計本段介紹 Kahneman 的研究路線：從人類非理性決策開始，發展到能預測決策錯誤的研究方法。
Heading vi 的定位概念是 successful approach 和 study of decision-making。Paragraph B
中間有幾個強證據：
“When Kahneman and his colleagues first started work, the idea of applying psychological insights to economics and business decisions was seen as rather bizarre.”
中文意思：當 Kahneman 和同事剛開始研究時，把心理學洞見應用到經濟和商業決策的想法被視
為相當怪異。
“But in the past decade the fields of behavioural finance and behavioural economics have blossomed, and in 2002 Kahneman shared a Nobel prize in economics for his work.”
中文意思：但在過去十年，行為金融和行為經濟學已蓬勃發展；2002 年，Kahneman 因其研究共
同獲得諾貝爾經濟學獎。
heading vi 中的 “successful approach” 對應 behavioural finance / behavioural economics
have blossomed 和 Nobel prize。 “study of decision-making” 對應 people’s inability to make logical decisions、economics and business decisions，以及 systematic and predictable mistakes。整段焦點是研究方法的成功發展，所以選 vi。
xi “Underestimating the difficulties ahead” 比較像 Paragraph C 的 over-optimism。
Paragraph B 沒有集中講人低估困難，而是講 Kahneman 的研究如何由怪異變成主流。

questions.answer: ix — The power of the first number
questions.answerKey: ix — The power of the first number
questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph D
Paragraph D 第一句是：
“Another source of wrong decisions is related to the decisive effect of the initial meeting, particularly in negotiations over money.”
中文意思：另一個錯誤決策來源，和初次會面產生的決定性影響有關，尤其是在金錢談判中。
最後一句是：
“If nobody has much information to go on, a figure can provide comfort—even though it may lead to a terrible mistake.”
中文意思：如果沒有人有太多資料可依靠，一個數字可以提供安全感，即使它可能導致嚴重錯誤。
只看首尾句，可以判斷本段圍繞 initial figure / first number 的心理力量。
heading ix 的核心是 first number。原文直接說：
“This is referred to as the ‘anchor effect’. Once a figure has been mentioned, it takes a strange hold over the human mind.”
中文意思：這被稱為 “anchor effect”。一旦某個數字被提及，它就會奇怪地抓住人的心智。
first number 對應 once a figure has been mentioned。power 對應 it takes a strange hold
over the human mind。房屋叫價、薪金談判、合併收購都是例子，用來說明第一個數字成為anchor，之後的談判會圍繞它展開。因此 heading ix 最能覆蓋全段。
x “The need for more effective risk assessment” 太廣，只像全文總方向。Paragraph D 講
的是一個具體偏誤：第一個數字的錨定效果。

questions.answer: iii — The difficulty of changing your mind
questions.answerKey: iii — The difficulty of changing your mind
questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph E
Paragraph E 第一句是：
“In addition, mistakes may arise due to stubbornness.”
中文意思：此外，錯誤可能來自固執。
最後一句是：
“A fresh eye always helps.”
中文意思：新的眼光總是有幫助。
首尾句已經提示本段講固執、既有看法和需要外部新視角。
heading iii 的核心是 changing your mind。原文有：
“No one likes to abandon a cherished belief, and the earlier a decision is made, the harder it is to abandon it.”
中文意思：沒有人喜歡放棄自己珍視的信念；一個決定愈早作出，就愈難放棄。
heading iii “The difficulty of changing your mind” 正好概括 “harder it is to abandon it”。後
面的 drug companies 和 analysts 是例子：藥廠不願承認研究項目失敗，分析師太早愛上一個解釋，使感知被染色。全段主旨是人很難放棄早期判斷或心愛信念，所以答案是 iii。
i “Not identifying the correct priorities” 也涉及錯誤決策，但它問的是時間和精力分配，屬
Paragraph G。Paragraph E 控制詞是 stubbornness、abandon、cherished belief。

questions.answer: viii — Reluctance to go beyond the familiar
questions.answerKey: viii — Reluctance to go beyond the familiar
questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph F
Paragraph F 第一句是：
“People also tend to put a lot of emphasis on things they have seen and experienced themselves, which may not be the best guide to decision-making.”
中文意思：人們也往往非常重視自己親眼見過和親身經歷過的事情，而這未必是決策的最佳指
引。
最後一句是：
“They would be much better off spreading their risks more widely.”
中文意思：如果他們把風險更廣泛地分散，情況會好得多。
只看首尾句，可以看到本段講 familiar experience 和 broader risk spreading 之間的問題。
heading viii 的核心是 familiar。原文中最強對應是：
“In finance, too much emphasis on information close at hand helps to explain the tendency of most investors to invest only within the country they live in.”
中文意思：在金融方面，過度重視手邊近處的資訊，有助解釋為何大多數投資者只投資自己居住
國家的股票。
Reluctance to go beyond the familiar 對應 invest only within the country they live in，以及
too much emphasis on information close at hand。後文說美國和歐洲投資者即使知道diversification 有益，仍然在本國股票上投資過重。這表示他們傾向留在熟悉環境，不願擴大投資範圍。
vii “The danger of trusting a global market” 方向不準。Paragraph F 的問題不是過度相信
全球市場；相反，投資者太集中於本國和熟悉資訊，沒有全球分散風險。

questions.answer: i — Not identifying the correct priorities
questions.answerKey: i — Not identifying the correct priorities
questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph G
Paragraph G 第一句是：
“More information is helpful in making any decision, but, says Kahneman, people spend proportionally too much time on small decisions and not enough on big ones.”
中文意思：更多資訊對任何決策都有幫助；但 Kahneman 說，人們按比例來看，在小決定上花太多
時間，在大決定上花太少時間。
最後一句是：
“During the boom years, some companies put as much effort into planning their office party as into considering strategic mergers.”
中文意思：在繁榮年份，有些公司花在計劃辦公室派對上的努力，和考慮策略性合併幾乎一樣多。
heading i 的核心是 correct priorities。原文 “too much time on small decisions and not
enough on big ones” 已經直接說出優先次序錯誤。
heading i “Not identifying the correct priorities” 對應人們未能把足夠精力投放於重大決
策。office party 與 strategic mergers 的對比尤其清楚：一個是小型內部活動，一個是重大商業策略，但公司投入的 effort 卻相近。這正是 priority 錯配。
x “The need for more effective risk assessment” 仍然太廣。Paragraph G 不只說風險評
估要更好，它具體指出時間與精力分配失衡。

questions.answer: iv — Why looking back is unhelpful
questions.answerKey: iv — Why looking back is unhelpful
questions.translation: 請依照下方步驟完成定位、細讀與答案判斷。

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph H
Paragraph H 第一句是：
“Finally, crying over spilt milk is not just a waste of time; it also often colours people’s perceptions of the future.”
中文意思：最後，為打翻的牛奶哭泣不只浪費時間；它也常常影響人們對未來的看法。
最後一句是：
“Some stock market investors trade far too frequently because they are chasing the returns on shares they wish they had bought earlier.”
中文意思：一些股票市場投資者交易過於頻繁，因為他們追逐那些自己希望早前買入的股票回
報。
heading iv 的核心是 looking back 和 unhelpful。原文的 crying over spilt milk 是英文習語，
意思是為已發生、不能改變的事後悔。
Paragraph H 說回望過去的錯失會扭曲對未來的判斷。投資者因為後悔沒有早點買某些股
票，便頻繁交易追逐回報。這種行為不是冷靜評估未來風險，而是由 regret 帶動。heading iv 完整概括本段。
i priorities 也可能吸引人，因為 “waste of time” 出現了。但本段重點轉向 regret and
future perception，不是大事小事的優先次序。

questions.answer: D — applied psychology to finance and economics
questions.answerKey: D — applied psychology to finance and economics
questions.prompt: People initially found Kahneman’s work unusual because he...
questions.translation: 人們起初覺得 Kahneman 的研究不尋常，是因為他……目標段落：Paragraph B

blocks.text: Paragraph B 第一、最後一句顯示本段介紹 Kahneman 對 irrational decision-making 的研
究，以及他認為錯誤有系統、可預測。這段會說明他的研究如何從怪異變成主流。
定位詞是 initially、unusual、Kahneman’s work。原文說：
“When Kahneman and his colleagues first started work, the idea of applying psychological insights to economics and business decisions was seen as rather bizarre.”
中文意思：當 Kahneman 和同事剛開始研究時，把心理學洞見應用到經濟和商業決策的想法被視
為相當怪異。
題目中的 initially 對應 when ... first started work。unusual 對應 rather bizarre。Kahneman

做的事是 applying psychological insights to economics and business decisions。選項 D 的finance and economics 雖然用 finance 替代 business decisions，但整段後面也出現 behavioural finance and behavioural economics，所以 D 最貼近原文。
A saw mistakes as following predictable patterns.這是 Kahneman 後來的 claim，原文放在段末，沒有說這是人們起初覺得怪異的原因。
B was unaware of behavioural approaches.原文沒有說他不知道 behavioural approaches；相反，他正是推動此方向的人。
C dealt with irrational types of practice.原文確實說 he showed how irrationally people behave in practice，但起初被視為 bizarre 的具體原因，是心理學被應用到 economics and business decisions。
D applied psychology to finance and economics.正確。它概括 “applying psychological insights to economics and business decisions” 以及behavioural finance / behavioural economics 的發展。

questions.answer: B — people tend to exaggerate their chances of success
questions.answerKey: B — people tend to exaggerate their chances of success
questions.prompt: The writer mentions homeowners’ attitudes towards the value of their homes to illustrate that...
questions.translation: 作者提到 homeowners 對自己房屋價值的看法，是為了說明……目標段落：Paragraph C

blocks.text: Paragraph C 第一、最後一句顯示本段主題是 over-optimism 和 overconfidence。它會說人
們看未來時太樂觀，低估困難，也高估自身能力。
定位詞是 homeowners、value of their homes。原文沒有用 homeowners，但說：
“The same goes for their hopes of ever-rising prices for their homes or doing well in games of chance.”
中文意思：他們希望自己的房屋價格永遠上升，或希望在機會遊戲中表現良好，情況也是一樣。
前文是：
“Surveys have shown that people’s forecasts of future stock market movements are far more optimistic than past long-term returns would justify.”
中文意思：調查顯示，人們對未來股市走勢的預測，比過去長期回報能支持的程度樂觀得多。
homeowners 的例子放在 over-optimism 段落中，用來說明人們對未來結果過度樂觀。
hopes of ever-rising prices 表示期待房屋價格一直上升，這是誇大成功機會或正面結果的例子。
A past failures may destroy an optimistic attitude.原文沒有說過去失敗會摧毀樂觀。它說即使 past experience suggests otherwise，人仍然 see too much blue sky ahead。
B people tend to exaggerate their chances of success.正確。房價永遠上升、機會遊戲成功和股市過度樂觀都屬於 over-optimism。
C optimism may be justified in certain circumstances.原文有說 optimism can be useful for managers or sportsmen，但 homeowners 例子用於展示過度樂觀，不是合理樂觀。
D people are influenced by the success of others.這較接近 Paragraph F 的 relative has made thousands on a share，不是 homeowners 例子。

questions.answer: D — are unwilling to give up unsuccessful activities or beliefs
questions.answerKey: D — are unwilling to give up unsuccessful activities or beliefs
questions.prompt: Stubbornness and inflexibility can cause problems when people...
questions.translation: 當人們……時，固執和不靈活會導致問題。

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph E
Paragraph E 第一、最後一句顯示本段講 stubbornness 和 fresh eye。這表示人容易卡在早
期判斷裡，需要新視角幫助。
定位詞是 stubbornness、inflexibility。原文說：
“No one likes to abandon a cherished belief, and the earlier a decision is made, the harder it is to abandon it.”
中文意思：沒有人喜歡放棄自己珍視的信念；決定愈早作出，就愈難放棄。
再看例子：
“Drug companies must decide early to cancel a failing research project to avoid wasting money, but may find it difficult to admit they have made a mistake.”
中文意思：藥廠必須及早決定取消失敗的研究項目，以免浪費金錢，但它們可能很難承認自己犯
了錯。
題目的 stubbornness and inflexibility 對應 no one likes to abandon、harder to abandon、
wedded early to a single explanation。選項 D 的 unsuccessful activities or beliefs 對應 failing research project 和 cherished belief / single explanation。
A think their financial difficulties are just due to bad luck.這像 Paragraph C 中 forgetting about luck 的概念，但不是 stubbornness 段落的主旨。
B avoid seeking advice from experts and analysts.原文提到 analysts，但不是說人避免向 analysts 求助，而是 analysts themselves may become wedded early to a single explanation。
C refuse to invest in the early stages of a project.原文談 cancel a failing research project，不是拒絕早期投資。
D are unwilling to give up unsuccessful activities or beliefs.正確。它概括 abandon a cherished belief、cancel a failing project、fresh eye helps。

questions.answer: A — They feel safer dealing in a context which is close to home.
questions.answerKey: A — They feel safer dealing in a context which is close to home.
questions.prompt: Why do many Americans and Europeans fail to spread their financial risks when investing?
questions.translation: 為何很多美國人和歐洲人投資時未能分散財務風險？

blocks.text: 目標段落：Paragraph F
Paragraph F 首尾句顯示本段講 familiar experience 和 broader risk spreading。這和題目
的 spread financial risks 直接相關。
定位詞是 Americans and Europeans、spread financial risks、investing。原文說：
“In finance, too much emphasis on information close at hand helps to explain the tendency of most investors to invest only within the country they live in.”
中文意思：在金融方面，過度重視手邊近處的資訊，有助解釋為何大多數投資者只投資自己居住
國家的股票。
再看：
“Even though they know that diversification is good for their portfolio, a large majority of both Americans and Europeans invest far too heavily in the shares of their home countries.”
中文意思：即使他們知道分散投資對投資組合有益，大多數美國人和歐洲人仍然在本國股票上投
資過重。
題目說 fail to spread their financial risks，原文說 they know diversification is good，但仍
invest far too heavily in home countries。原因是 too much emphasis on information close at hand，即他們更相信熟悉、近身、本國的資訊。選項 A 的 close to home 正好概括這點。
A They feel safer dealing in a context which is close to home.正確。close to home 對應 information close at hand 和 shares of their home countries。
B They do not understand the benefits of diversification.錯在方向相反。原文說 Even though they know diversification is good。
C They are over-influenced by the successes of their relatives.原文有 relative made thousands 的例子，但那只是說明 personal experience 偏誤，未專門解釋Americans and Europeans 投資集中於本國。
D They do not have sufficient knowledge of one another’s countries.原文沒有說他們缺乏其他國家的知識；它說他們過度依賴近身資訊。

questions.prompt: Which two occupations may benefit from being over-optimistic?
questions.translation: 哪兩種職業可能會受益於過度樂觀？

blocks.text: 字數限制：NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。題目問 two occupations，所以要找兩個職業名詞。
目標段落：Paragraph C
Paragraph C 首句說：
“One common cause of problems in decision-making is over-optimism.”
中文意思：決策問題的一個常見原因是過度樂觀。
最後一句談競爭性活動中人們忘記要和對手比較技能。只看首尾句，可以估計本段會講over-optimism / overconfidence 的例子和類型。
定位詞是 over-optimistic、benefit、occupations。原文說：
“Such optimism can be useful for managers or sportsmen, and sometimes turns into a self-fulfilling prophecy.”
中文意思：這種樂觀對經理或運動員可能有用，有時還會變成自我實現的預言。
題目問 may benefit from being over-optimistic，原文用 can be useful。occupations 對應
managers 和 sportsmen。答案最好保留原文形式 “managers or sportsmen”，剛好三個 words，符合限制。
may benefit from= can be useful for being over-optimistic= such optimism答案形式：managers or sportsmen
不要填 “managers and sportsmen” 也可以理解，但原文用 or。考試答案通常接受兩者；
保守做法是抄原文短語 “managers or sportsmen”。

questions.prompt: Which practical skill are many people over-confident about?
questions.translation: 很多人對哪一項實用技能過度自信？

blocks.text: 字數限制：NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。題目問 skill，答案多數是一個名詞或動名詞。
目標段落：Paragraph C
同一段首句講 over-optimism，後半轉入 Kahneman 的三種 overconfidence。題目有
over-confident，所以應在 Paragraph C 後半找。
定位詞是 practical skill、over-confident。原文說：
“First, people tend to exaggerate their own skill and prowess; in polls, far fewer than half the respondents admit to having below-average skills in, say, driving.”
中文意思：第一，人們傾向誇大自己的技能和能力；在民意調查中，遠少於一半的受訪者承認自己
在例如駕駛方面低於平均水平。
題目問哪項 practical skill。原文例子是 driving。句中 far fewer than half admit
below-average skills 表示大多數人不願承認自己低於平均，即高估自己的駕駛能力。答案是一個字，符合限制。
over-confident about= exaggerate their own skill and prowess practical skill= driving答案形式：driving
不要填 “skill and prowess”。那是概括詞，不是題目問的具體 practical skill。

questions.prompt: Which type of business has a generally good attitude to dealing with uncertainty?
questions.translation: 哪一類企業在處理不確定性方面通常態度較好？

blocks.text: 字數限制：NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS。題目問 type of business，要找行業或公司類別。
目標段落：Paragraph I
Paragraph I 首句是：
“Kahneman reckons that some types of businesses are much better than others at dealing with risk.”
中文意思：Kahneman 認為，有些類型的企業比其他企業更善於處理風險。
最後一句說 governments 因面對政治壓力，更容易作出 irrational decisions。只看首尾句，可以估計本段比較不同組織處理 risk 的能力。
定位詞是 type of business、good attitude、uncertainty。原文說：
“Pharmaceutical companies, which are accustomed to many failures and a few big successes in their drug-discovery programmes, are fairly rational about their risk-taking.”
中文意思：製藥公司習慣於藥物發現計劃中有許多失敗和少數重大成功，因此在承擔風險方面相
當理性。
題目中的 dealing with uncertainty 對應 dealing with risk / risk-taking。generally good
attitude 對應 fairly rational。type of business 對應 Pharmaceutical companies。答案兩個 words，符合限制。
good attitude to dealing with uncertainty= fairly rational about their risk-taking type of business= Pharmaceutical companies答案形式：Pharmaceutical companies
banks 也在同段出現，但 Kahneman 說 banks have a long way to go，代表仍需改善；它
們不是 good attitude 的例子。

paragraphOverview.title: Skim Roadmap：只看每段第一句和最後一句後可合理看到的全文地圖
paragraphOverview.intro: 先掌握每段的功能與主旨，再進入逐題定位和細讀分析。

paragraphs.summary: 首句直接說人們對未來作出 terrible decisions，先把全文定位在「風險判斷錯誤」。末句用問句“Surely there must be a better way than using intuition?” 收結，暗示文章會批評 intuition，並尋找較科學的決策方法。只看首尾句，可以估計 Paragraph A 是總引入段：人類處理 uncertainty 時經常低估或高估風險，全文接下來會說明直覺為何不可靠，以及哪些心理偏誤導致錯判。

首句介紹 Daniel Kahneman 在 1960s 開始研究人們不能作出 logical decisions 的問題。末句說他認為這些 mistakes 並非 random，而是 systematic and predictable。只看首尾句，可以估計Paragraph B 會介紹 Kahneman 的研究背景和貢獻：他把心理學洞見帶入 economics、business decisions、behavioural finance，後來獲 Nobel prize。這段不是一個具體偏誤，而是講研究方法如何成功建立一門解釋決策錯誤的學問。

首句說決策問題的一個常見來源是 over-optimism。末句說在競爭性活動如 dealing on shares 中，人們忘記自己要和競爭者比較技能。只看首尾句，可以估計 Paragraph C 講過度樂觀和過度自信：人們預期股市、樓價或機會遊戲時太樂觀，也會高估自己的能力、控制力和競爭優勢。題目若問 homeowners、over-confidence、driving、managers 或 sportsmen，多數在此段。

首句說另一個錯誤決策來源和 initial meeting 的 decisive effect 有關，尤其在 money negotiations 中。末句說如果沒有人有足夠資料，一個數字會令人安心，雖然它可能導致 terrible mistake。只看首尾句，可以估計 Paragraph D 講 anchor effect：第一次提出的數字會抓住人心，影響房屋價格、薪金談判、公司合併與收購。題目若問 first number 或 initial figure，答案應在 D。

首句用 In addition 開始，指出錯誤也可能來自 stubbornness。末句說 “A fresh eye always helps.”只看首尾句，可以估計 Paragraph E 講人很難改變既有想法或放棄早期決定。中間應該會有failing research project、drug companies、analysts 之類例子，說明人會持續投入失敗項目，或太早愛上一個解釋。題目若問 changing your mind、inflexibility、give up unsuccessful activities，應看 E。
首句說人們往往過度重視自己親眼看過和親身經歷過的事情。末句說他們若把風險更廣泛分散，情況會好得多。只看首尾句，可以估計 Paragraph F 講 familiar information 的偏誤：人會信任身邊例子，例如親戚買股票賺錢，也會把投資集中在本國股票。段落方向應是批評投資者不願離開熟悉市場，因此沒有做好 diversification。

首句說更多資訊有助決策，但 Kahneman 認為人們花太多時間在 small decisions，太少時間在big ones。末句用 office party 和 strategic mergers 對比，說有些公司把計劃辦公室派對和考慮策略性合併放在近乎同等努力。只看首尾句，可以估計 Paragraph G 講 priority 錯配：資源、時間和注意力沒有放在真正重要的大決策上。題目若問 priorities，應看 G。
首句說 crying over spilt milk 不只浪費時間，也常常影響人們對未來的看法。末句說一些股票投資者交易過於頻繁，因為他們追逐自己早前希望買入的股票回報。只看首尾句，可以估計Paragraph H 講後悔和回望如何扭曲未來決策。段落重點是 past regrets 令投資者追趕錯過的機會，形成不理性的交易行為。題目若問 looking back unhelpful，應看 H。

首句說 Kahneman 認為某些 business 比其他 business 更善於處理 risk。末句說 governments也受到研究啟發，因為它們面對互相衝突的 political pressures，更容易作出 irrational decisions。只看首尾句，可以估計 Paragraph I 是應用與總結段：不同組織處理風險的能力不同； pharmaceutical companies 因熟悉大量失敗和少數成功，較理性；banks 和 governments 仍有改進空間。
